ai_show_review.summary: Vibrant late‑show with soaring Easy Wind, Cosmic Charlie & jam‑heavy set
ai_show_review.blurb: The performance is packed with energetic covers and deep‑cut originals, highlighted by a soaring Easy Wind, a fiery Dancin' jam and the powerful Midnight Hour → Turn On Your Lovelight transition. Jerry’s guitar shines throughout while Phil’s bass drives the extended improvisations. The audience tape captures the excitement despite occasional cut‑offs.
ai_show_review.review: Port Chester’s Capitol Theater saw the Dead in late March 1970 unleash a marathon of vintage rock ’n’ roll, folk‑rock staples and jam‑heavy explorations that still feel fresh today. Kicking off with a tight Casey Jones and a rollicking Dancin' In The Street, the first half built momentum into an inspired Easy Wind where Jerry’s melodic lead and Bob’s soaring solo stole the show. The set then roamed through fan favorites—Friend Of The Devil, Wake Up Little Susie, Katie Mae—and launched into a high‑octane second act highlighted by Cosmic Charlie, Saint Stephen into Not Fade Away, and a blistering Midnight Hour that resolved into Turn On Your Lovelight. Though captured from audience tape with the usual quirks of missing cuts and occasional speed tweaks, the recording preserves the band’s chemistry: Jerry’s tone is spot‑on, Phil supplies inventive bass lines reminiscent of his Caution jam era, and Bob drives crowd interaction with gusto. For anyone hunting a late‑show snapshot of the early ’70s Dead, this set delivers both historic flavor and timeless fire.

rating_calculation.sentiment_rationale: All three recordings are marked positive, praising numerous songs (Easy Wind, Dancin', Midnight Hour → Lovelight, Casey Jones, Cosmic Charlie) and noting flawless band performance with no negative criticism. Consistent enthusiasm across sources justifies a strong positive sentiment boost.

best_recording.reason: Good‑quality audience tape with clear crowd ambience and balanced set, despite minor missing cuts; captures the show’s energy best.

key_highlights: Stellar Easy Wind performance with Jerry’s perfect tone and Bob’s solo.
Fire‑filled Dancin' jam that launches the late‑show improvisations.
Cosmic Charlie and Saint Stephen > Not Fade Away sequence delivering high energy.
Midnight Hour → Turn On Your Lovelight transition adds dramatic punch.

band_performance.Jerry: Delivers flawless, melodic lead work throughout—especially on Easy Wind—and adds a playful touch on Midnight Hour.
band_performance.Phil: Provides inventive, peak‑era bass lines that drive the extended jams, notably during the Dancin' and Cosmic Charlie sections.
band_performance.Bob: Offers an outstanding solo on Easy Wind and fuels crowd interaction with energetic rhythm guitar throughout the set.
